title: Idempotent projection for a pair henselization fibre
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, I an ideal and c a colimit cocone of the full category of etale maps A to D inducing bijections A/I to D/ID. Write B=c.pt.right, f:A to B, and suppose B is Noetherian. Let C be a commutative ring, g:B to C, q a prime of B, p its contraction, and rho:kappa(p) to kappa(q) the canonical A-algebra residue map. Give C the B-algebra structure from g and A-algebra structure from g composed with f. If phi:p.Fiber C to q.Fiber C is a ring homomorphism satisfying phi(x tensor y)=rho(x) tensor y on every pure tensor, then there is e in p.Fiber C such that e is idempotent, phi(e)=1, phi is surjective, and every x in ker(phi) satisfies e*x=0.

proof.text: Use pair_henselization_filtered and pair_henselization_essentiallySmall to reindex the full pair-etale category along equivSmallModel. Apply the inverse of commAlgCatEquivUnder to the given colimit cocone; isColimitOfPreserves and coconePointUniqueUpToIso give an A-algebra equivalence from B=c.pt.right to the chosen small algebra colimit. Apply filteredEtale_fiber_structure, and transport reducedness and Krull dimension at most zero along its tensor equivalence. The fibre is Noetherian by isNoetherianRing_fiber, hence Artinian by Mathlib IsNoetherianRing.isArtinianRing_of_krullDimLE_zero.

Apply fibre_primes_residue_fields to identify the prime spectrum of the fibre with the primes F of B over p, including the equality of the canonical residue-field composite with the tensor evaluation map psi. The fibre is reduced Artinian, so Mathlib IsArtinianRing.equivPi decomposes it as the product of quotients at maximal ideals. Reindex by primeSpectrumEquivMaximalSpectrum and the given spectrum equivalence. For each maximal ideal the quotient-to-residue-field map is bijective by Ideal.bijective_algebraMap_quotient_residueField. Compose it with the residue-field equivalence from fibre_primes_residue_fields. Equality with RingHom.pi psi follows pointwise from its canonical composite equality. Thus F is finite and RingHom.pi psi is bijective. The residue-field equivalences chosen here are uniquely determined by their composites with the surjective residue maps, not arbitrary witnesses of mere existence.

Precompose the canonical ring equivalence with tensor symmetry to obtain B tensor_A kappa(p) to the residue product. Its B-algebra compatibility follows on algebraMap(b)=b tensor 1 because each residue component sends 1 to 1. Tensor this equivalence with C over B, use cancelBaseChange and the finite-product form Algebra.TensorProduct.piRight from Mathlib/RingTheory/TensorProduct/Pi.lean (the finite iteration of the binary-product calculation), and tensor symmetry. On a pure tensor x tensor y, the q coordinate is y tensor rho(x), directly by the pure-tensor formulas; symmetry gives rho(x) tensor y, equal to phi(x tensor y) by hypothesis. TensorProduct.induction_on extends this equality to every element.

Let q0 be q as an element of F. Pull back Pi.single q0 1 through the product ring equivalence T. Injectivity of T and pointwise multiplication prove idempotence. The coordinate identity with phi proves phi(e)=1. For any z in q.Fiber C, Pi.single q0 (Q.symm z), where Q is tensor symmetry, pulls back to a preimage of z, proving surjectivity. If phi(x)=0, Q.injective implies the q0 coordinate of T(x) vanishes. At q0 the product T(e)*T(x) is therefore zero; elsewhere T(e) is zero. Injectivity of T proves e*x=0. Pi.single and tensor symmetry allow zero factors, so no nontriviality of C or of any factor is used.

lean.statement:
theorem pair_henselization_fiber_projection
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (c : Cocone (ObjectProperty.ι
      (fun D : Under (CommRingCat.of A) ↦
        AlgebraicGeometry.Etale (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map D.hom) ∧
          Function.Bijective (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map D.hom.hom) D.hom.hom
            (Ideal.le_comap_map)))))
    (hc : IsColimit c) [IsNoetherianRing c.pt.right]
    (C : Type u) [CommRing C] (g : c.pt.right →+* C)
    (q : Ideal c.pt.right) [q.IsPrime] :
    letI := c.pt.hom.hom.toAlgebra
    letI := g.toAlgebra
    letI := (g.comp c.pt.hom.hom).toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower A c.pt.right C :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
    let p := q.comap c.pt.hom.hom
    ∀ (ρ : p.ResidueField →ₐ[A] q.ResidueField),
      ρ = Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ p q (Algebra.ofId A c.pt.right) rfl →
    ∀ (φ : p.Fiber C →+* q.Fiber C),
      (∀ (x : p.ResidueField) (y : C),
        φ (TensorProduct.tmul A x y) = TensorProduct.tmul c.pt.right (ρ x) y) →
      ∃ e : p.Fiber C, IsIdempotentElem e ∧ φ e = 1 ∧
        Function.Surjective φ ∧ ∀ x, φ x = 0 → e * x = 0
